name: jeebhar
description: Jeebhar — social media marketing site for restaurants and food brands (React + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix server run lint:fix && npm --prefix client run lint:fix
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
